continuity_scope: Amazon Prime Video's animated The Legend of Vox Machina continuity only, bounded to Season 1 Episodes 1–2 ("The Terror of Tal'Dorei – Part 1" and "The Terror of Tal'Dorei – Part 2") and selected official Prime Video/Critical Role/Amazon material. The Critical Role Campaign One livestream, comics, sourcebooks, games, and later animated episodes/seasons are excluded rather than merged.
work_or_witnesses: The Legend of Vox Machina, S1 E1–E2, official Prime Video episode listings
Amazon Prime Video/Critical Role 2019 series announcement
Critical Role official animation page and official Season 1 sticker product listing, used only for animated-series identity and canonical ensemble-name spelling
coverage_rule: Include the seven named individual Vox Machina dramatic ensemble members visible in the selected opening pair—Vex'ahlia, Vax'ildan, Keyleth, Percival de Rolo, Pike Trickfoot, Scanlan Shorthalt, and Grog Strongjaw—plus Sovereign Uriel, the named individual who commissions the party in E1 and receives its E2 report. Adventuring classes/roles, peoples/species, magic, artifacts, factions, places, monsters, and game-derived concepts remain terms or omissions.
omissions: All other named/unnamed E1–E2 figures, including the monster as a category rather than a personal individual, are outside this reproducible core-ensemble-plus-commissioner rule.
The Campaign One livestream, its tabletop mechanics and character sheets, comics, sourcebooks, games, later animated episodes/seasons, and other Critical Role continuities are excluded.

The opening pair is TV-MA and includes violent monster-threat context, crude/adult humor, and alcohol/ale references. This pass does not reproduce gore, sexual content, intoxication detail, substance-use diagnosis, consent claims, injury outcomes, or later trauma.
No real-world race/ethnicity, species, disability/body, gender, sexuality, class, religion, or adaptation-equivalence conclusion is inferred from fictional designs, roles, or the source campaign.
uncertainties: Prime Video's accessible episode listings are localized metadata; their content is used only for the E1 commission and E2 report/tracking premise, not for an English-script reconstruction.

Official Critical Role material distinguishes the animated series from the earlier campaign but does not authorize importing campaign-specific class, race, pronoun, relationship, or backstory data into this animated pass.
The exact individual identity, nature, and defeat of the E1–E2 monster are intentionally not resolved from the selected compact synopses.
evidence_basis: Official Prime Video E1–E2 metadata plus official Amazon/Critical Role animated-series materials only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, campaign transcript, tabletop sourcebook, game database, or later-season reference is used as evidence.
